name: others
_note: Partners/opponents (MODEL): every robot close to ours (user's choice 2026-10-30: show the scoring limit, an Einstein-like field, not stronger than real robots). One quality q per robot and reset; q = 1 is about our robot (FRC 254 numbers).

by_quality._note: [value at q=0, value at q=1(, gamma)]: v1 + (v0 - v1) * (1 - q)**gamma. A weak robot is slower in several ways (drive speed and acceleration, mechanism and alignment time at most 2x / 2.5x, more misses) instead of mostly standing still (times 5x and alignment 7x before 2026-10-30). tools/calib_others.py solo, pieces per match relative to our robot: q 0 0.50, 0.25 0.62, 0.5 0.77, 0.75 0.86, 1 1.04; quality U(0.8, 1.0) gives 0.88-1.04 (2025 Champs division quals were p10 0.30, p50 0.61, p90 0.85).
